props.headline: About MyPoojaBooking - Connecting
props.subheadline: India's trusted online pooja and seva booking platform, bringing the sacred traditions of India's holiest temples to your doorstep.

props.title: Bridging Devotion and Technology
description: MyPoojaBooking (mypoojabooking.com) is an authorised online seva and pooja booking platform based in Mangaluru, Karnataka, India. Founded by Kochikar Technologies LLP, it serves as the official digital booking partner of onboarded Hindu temples across India, enabling devotees to book temple sevas, access festival calendars, and stay connected with their chosen temples from anywhere in the world.

Unlike general pandit-booking platforms, MyPoojaBooking works directly with temple administrations, ensuring every booking is officially acknowledged by the temple. We leverage advanced cloud infrastructure to ensure that every ritual is authenticated, and every devotee can participate in seva regardless of where they are in the world.
